evidence: All recorded Newton iterations across all 35 entries have step_2 equal to the active trust radius under the frozen diagnostic tolerance.
All 30 MAXIMUM_ITERATIONS entries have zero rejected Newton steps; they continue making accepted but trust-capped progress until the iteration limit.

The CP01R1 kernel expands the radius only when an accepted full-factor step reduces residual below 0.25 of its current value; this >=75% single-step reduction condition was not met in the recorded slow-progress regime.
D1_F01.label: TRUST_REGION_CAP_STARVATION
D1_F01.not_proved: Does not prove that scaled trust-region Newton will find a root.

evidence: The runtime stores a continuation state only when primary_candidate is already true.
CP01R1 had zero primary candidates, therefore no coarse terminal state was prolonged; every mesh started from its same-index fresh seven_seeds(node_count) state.
D1_F02.label: NO_PROGRESS_CONTINUATION_OCCURRED
D1_F02.not_proved: Does not prove that coarse-to-fine progress continuation will reach the desired basin.

evidence: R_4D is the dominant N=96 boundary residual for all seven seeds.
N=96 |R_4D| spans 1.1252699553439607 to 1.408873406960302 versus the unchanged 1e-10 boundary acceptance limit.
D1_F03.label: PERSISTENT_R4D_JUNCTION_OBSTRUCTION
D1_F03.not_proved: Cannot distinguish physical boundary incompatibility from failure to approach a root because no local root neighborhood was reached.

evidence: Median final discrete condition estimates rise from 4.511e8 at N=24 to 2.864e11 at N=96.
Final rank deficit appears once at N=64 and twice at N=96.
D1_F04.label: FINE_MESH_CONDITIONING_DEGRADATION
D1_F04.not_proved: Discrete conditioning/rank does not establish continuum Jacobian rank or Fredholm properties.

evidence: The canonical seed adapter uses amplitude scale 1/20 and multipliers with maximum absolute value 1/2, i.e. a maximum scalar displacement coefficient 0.025 along one fixed direction.
Across all 35 fresh starts the initial residual infinity norm spans only 1.6265939343090037 to 1.62829175487399.
D1_F05.label: SEED_BASIN_COVERAGE_NARROW
D1_F05.not_proved: Does not establish that a root exists outside these basins.

primary_nonlinear_method.acceptance: trial must be admissible, lower original residual_inf, and rho>=0.1; deterministic 0.5 backtracking up to 20 steps if needed
primary_nonlinear_method.column_equilibration: c_j=max(||J[:,j]||_2,1e-12); solve in z-coordinates with dx=diag(1/c_j) dz
primary_nonlinear_method.linear_solver: SVD minimum-norm solve of W J diag(1/c) with relative singular cutoff 1e-12; record raw and scaled ranks/condition estimates at every iteration
primary_nonlinear_method.merit_for_acceptance: ORIGINAL_UNSCALED residual infinity norm; scaling can never satisfy an acceptance gate
primary_nonlinear_method.name: ETRN-01_EQUILIBRATED_TRUST_REGION_NEWTON
primary_nonlinear_method.radius_update: rho<0.25 => x0.25; rho>0.75 and ||dz||>=0.8*Delta => x2 up to 64; otherwise unchanged
primary_nonlinear_method.rank_deficiency_policy: Transient scaled rank deficiency uses the preregistered truncated-SVD minimum-norm step and is recorded; final candidate remains subject to unchanged condition/high-precision QA and cannot be promoted by rank regularization.
primary_nonlinear_method.row_equilibration: w_i=1/max(||J_scaled[i,:]||_2,1e-12); row scaling is linear-solve preconditioning only

progress_continuation.N24_initialization: same fresh CP01R1 seed for that seed index
progress_continuation.N_gt_24_initialization: Prolongate the immediately preceding mesh terminal state only if it is finite, admissible, not timed out, and final original residual_inf <= 0.90 * that stage initial original residual_inf; otherwise use the same-index fresh CP01R1 seed at that mesh.
progress_continuation.interpretation: This is deterministic basin continuation, not an acceptance relaxation; only original equations and original acceptance gates can create a candidate.

cp01r2_protocol_design.purpose: Test the leading algorithmic failure hypothesis while holding the physical sector fixed; do not broaden parameter or topology space in CP01R2.
required_pre_execution_implementation_te: Synthetic linear/scaled systems verify trust radius can expand under high-quality clipped progress without requiring a 75% residual drop.
Scaling transforms must preserve a zero of the original residual equations; acceptance is computed only on original residuals.
Deterministic progress-continuation branch selection is reproducible and never uses random/adaptive states.
Raw and scaled rank/condition channels are both captured.
No physical solve capability exists in implementation-review CI.

deferred_if_cp01r2_negative: Do not widen physical parameters/topology inside CP01R2.
Only after a separately reviewed negative CP01R2 may a later protocol consider wider deterministic basin seeds or an exact-endpoint numerical homotopy.

root_cause_ranking.cause: trust-region geometry/scale starvation plus an expansion rule that is too restrictive for clipped slow progress
absence of progress-based coarse-to-fine continuation once local-root gate is unmet
fine-mesh ill-conditioning and transient/final rank loss
actual incompatibility of the frozen physical junction sector
